त्रैशानि

TRAIŚĀNI . A King of the family of turvasu. He was the father of karandhama. (See under Vaṁśāvali).

त्रैवलि

TRAIVALI (traibali) . A sage. He shone as a membe in the court of yudhiṣṭhira. (Śloka 13, Chapter 4, Sabhā Parva).

त्रैवर्णिकस्

TRAIVARṆIKA(S) . Brahmins, Kṣatriyas and Vaiśyas are the three castes of people called traivarṇikas.
